changed_assumption: Installed default pipeline IR does not preserve active cross-stage tied aliases. Graph representation does not prove stock storage preservation.
decision: GENERIC_ONLY for physical-layer-stationary cyclic prefill with the granted matched generic baseline. No architecture-wide performance rejection.
baseline_grants: Identical physical weight owners and buffers
Identical causal chunk DAG and recurrent norms
Identical depth-indexed KV ownership, versions, capacity, and publication
Identical kernels and boundary tensor representation
Identical streams, events, messages, and schedule freedom
trace_identity: Map each operation, allocation, message, synchronization event, and resource order identically. The constructed generic executor reproduces the physical trace. This is not a stock-runtime Ouro performance result.

structural_accounting.dense_definition: Four H-by-H attention matrices plus three H-by-I MLP matrices. H=2048,I=5632. Excludes non-core tensors, scratch, and overhead.
structural_accounting.message_caveat: Native internal layer cuts retain hidden and residual. The one-row case is not a verified BF16 native boundary representation. Charge actual tensors, metadata, synchronization, and routing.
structural_accounting.frontier_correction: min(P,C) was a current-token decode bound. Known causal prefill chunks can supply work at C=1 without stale inputs.

latency_condition.definitions: T_C0/T_T0 are fixed-schedule zero-network-cost makespans with actual compute, kernel shapes, KV dependencies, local control, buffers, and resource orders. D_C=T_C-T_C0. D_T=T_T-T_T0.
latency_condition.classification: Accounting identity, not a measured prediction.
latency_condition.lower_bound_rule: Use max(slowest-owner service bound, longest dependency-path bound). Do not sum overlapping bounds. A measured component is not a universal lower bound. State kernel, grouping, fusion, and scheduling restrictions.
latency_condition.E2E_warning: Completed cohort controls include 128 decode tokens. They do not isolate prefill time.

unresolved_distinct_mechanism: None identified under identical aliases, chunk DAG, KV ownership, and schedule freedom. A different ownership mechanism would need an explicit non-identical cost and a matched generic control.
time_scope: One actual worker interval through the recorded verification cutoff. Concurrent worker intervals do not add campaign elapsed time.
